method: Actual live mapping callback is GridMap::cloudOdomCallback for pose_type=2. It performs lookupTransform(world, cloud.frame_id, cloud.header.stamp); no odometry/extrinsic fallback is used in this implementation.

Recorded TF is replayed through tf2 BufferCore, with interpolation at exact scan source stamp. Chain world-map-camera_init-body-livox_frame uses recorded static body-to-LiDAR calibration, not launch lidar_offset in its place.
Cloud geometry is compared to the 47 fixed collision spheres at odometry source-time interpolated x/y/yaw. Configured world sphere heights are preserved; odometry z is not added.
Hard radius is exported radius, including one 0.05m voxel margin. Physical-sphere radius removes that margin; it remains a model radius, not a measured physical surface.

Source configured range abs(sensor xyz)<(8,8,3) and world z>=0.15 are reported as an eligible subset. Launch disables downstream box self filter. No claim is made that this frame was accepted, fused, or caused a queried voxel.
Only extracted small NPZ/JSONL files are opened. No robot node, ROS publisher, service or large bag is used.
limitations: The observed near points are not identified as robot self returns, ground returns, or physical external objects from these files alone.
Input existence does not prove callback acceptance, pending-frame selection, raycasting fusion, occupancy persistence, or responsibility for the exact live-layer stop.
The downstream world-height gate is 0.15m; near examples have world z about0.20m and therefore are not removed by this gate.

The source-configured acceptance filters are reconstructed from captured exp0_real.launch and its current referenced piper_advanced_param.xml. Exact source-stamped TF is recorded, not inferred from mount defaults.
native_planar_frame preserves world z and expresses x/y in planar robot axes, matching native fixed-sphere convention; it is not a full URDF base_link transform.

self_filter_condition_check.condition: outside_self_spheres deletes if any squared center distance <= (physical radius +0.01)^2; filter_self_cloud explicitly calls padding=.01. This margin is a literal, not an unrecorded ROS parameter.
self_filter_condition_check.configuration_evidence: Captured exp0_real.launch enables filter_self=true and routes its mapping_output to /velodyne_points_mapping. Recorded snapshot fixed geometry comes from the same planner parameter group used by PiperArmModel.from_parameters. No separate live self-filter parameter dump was saved.
self_filter_condition_check.fixed_geometry_replay: Exact recorded scan-stamped world->base_link TF is used here, matching self filter. Exporter fixed radius minus recorded resolution reconstructs physical fixed radius. Fixed spheres do not depend on arm q.
self_filter_condition_check.arm_scope: The pure67-sphere function uses the nearest recorded arm sphere snapshot, not exact self-filter joint-history interpolation. Fixed-only inclusion is exact for recorded geometry; arm gap and timestamp delta are disclosed. Actual retention is directly evidenced by these points being present on post-filter mapping output.
self_filter_condition_check.interpretation: All four candidates are just outside the1cm self-filter envelope while inside the5cm fixed-structure collision guard. This is consistent with retention by the configured filter. It does not classify these points as robot returns or real obstacles, and does not establish their fusion or responsibility for stop.
